elevate.move: Art-direct the plates as one shoot of one desert backyard through the year: a shared warm late-sun grade on every plate and frames that show the pool in a local yard (cover, drain, tile, monsoon, pour), each captioned with its month, so the plates themselves read as the almanac's calendar.

Make the cover a true almanac cover: masthead, issue line and month strip on one ruled plate over a homeowner-scale pool picture, with folio 00's Contents peeking 80-120px under the fold so the first screen already promises the year's index.
